title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Lead
description:
Salary: £45,000 to £55,000


Location: Macclesfield


Working pattern: Full-time, permanent, Monday to Friday, hybrid (one or two days a week in the Electroserv office, the rest from home or visiting sister businesses as needed)


Role overview

Electroserv supplies process control and instrumentation to UK manufacturers and machine builders. Together with our sister businesses, we are growing fast and want AI to help every team do more.


As our first AI Lead, you will find, build and embed practical AI tools across the group. The aim is better efficiency, customer service and sales performance, with tools and costs shared effectively between businesses. You will start with a blank canvas and shape how a whole group of businesses uses AI. You will report directly to the Managing Director, so decisions are quick, and you will have an AI and training budget. Your work will make a visible impact on a business targeting £5m turnover.


What you will be doing

  • Getting to know each business and finding where AI can save the most time

  • Building and rolling out practical tools, from quote drafting to product search and email triage

  • Connecting AI to the systems we already use, such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce and ERP

  • Training and supporting colleagues so they use AI confidently and safely

  • Setting our AI policy, managing tools and costs, and reporting the results


What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • Month 3: You have visited every business, and a prioritised use-case list and group AI policy are agreed

  • Month 6: At least 3 tools are live (e.g. quote drafting, product search, email triage) and champions are in place

  • Month 12: Tools are used in every business, with measured time savings reported across the group


What you will bring

  • Proven, hands-on experience deploying AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in a business to solve real problems

  • Strong practical skills with automation and no-code/low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, Zapier, Make)

  • Comfort working with business data: spreadsheets, CRM and ERP records, product catalogues

  • The ability to explain technical ideas in plain English and train non-technical colleagues

  • A self-starter approach, managing priorities across several businesses with little supervision

  • Working knowledge of UK GDPR and safe handling of confidential data

  • Full UK driving licence (travel between sites)


Desirable

  • Background in industrial distribution, engineering, manufacturing or B2B technical sales

  • Scripting or coding experience (Python, JavaScript) and working with APIs

  • Experience with Salesforce (configuration, automation or integrations), Microsoft 365, SharePoint and ERP systems

  • Experience with Google AI tools (e.g. Gemini, Google Workspace AI) and Wix’s AI website features

  • Project or change management experience in an SME

  • Familiarity with process control or instrumentation products


What’s on offer

  • Salary of £45,000 to £55,000

  • Hybrid working

  • Total holiday package of 31 days

  • Company pension

  • Health and Wellbeing Cash Plan

  • Free gym membership next to Electroserv HQ

  • Free onsite parking

  • Modern open-plan office with a pool table and collaboration spaces

  • Employee Mentoring Program, with opportunities to grow and mentor

  • Company events to celebrate wins

  • Employer-sponsored office attire


How to apply

Please send your CV and a short note describing one AI tool you built or rolled out, and what difference it made.
